plugin-data.name: Backup Manager
plugin-data.description: Create and restore complete backups of your Bludit site. Backs up all content, databases, uploads, and configurations.

no-backups: No backups found. Click 'Create Backup Now' to create your first backup.
zip-available: ZIP compression is available and will be used for backups.
zip-unavailable: ZIP compression is not available. Backups will be stored as folders.
encryption-enabled: AES-256 encryption is ENABLED. All new backups will be encrypted.
encryption-disabled: Encryption is disabled. Set a password below to enable AES-256 encryption.
confirm-restore: Are you sure you want to restore this backup? Current data will be backed up first.
confirm-delete: Are you sure you want to delete this backup?
max-backups: Maximum number of backups to keep
max-backups-help: Older backups will be automatically deleted
backup-password-placeholder: Enter a strong password for AES-256 encryption
backup-password-warning: WARNING: If you lose this password, encrypted backups cannot be restored!
password-required: Please set an encryption password in Settings before creating backups.
set-password-first: Please set an encryption password in Settings above to enable backup creation.
restore-requires-pro: Restore functionality requires Bludit PRO. Available at https://pro.bludit.com
leave-empty-to-keep-current: Leave empty to keep the current password
